rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The HTB MCP Server provides a bridge to the HackTheBox API, enabling AI assistants to interact with the cybersecurity learning platform through natural language commands. Built in Go with comprehensive tool coverage, it exposes 12 core tools including listing and filtering challenges/machines, starting instances, retrieving connection details, submitting flags, and accessing user progress data, all authenticated via JWT token. The server supports both active and retired content with advanced filtering by difficulty, category, and operating system, making it valuable for cybersecurity education workflows, automated lab management, and integrating hands-on hacking practice into AI-driven learning experiences.
